summary.text: Mitchell Jacob is the Democratic nominee in Oklahoma's 4th District. A Tulsa native and U.S. Army veteran who served as a Sergeant and Cryptologic Linguist, he earned a law degree from the University of Oklahoma in 2025 and works as a public defender. He ran for the Oklahoma House of Representatives in 2024 and says he is running on fiscal responsibility, public education and criminal justice reform.

paragraphs.text: Born in Tulsa, Oklahoma, and describes himself as a fourth-generation Oklahoman.

Earned a high school diploma from Boulder Creek High School, an associate degree from Rio Salado College (2016), a bachelor's degree from Grand Canyon University (2019), and a law degree from the University of Oklahoma College of Law (2025).
Served in the U.S. Army from 2017 to 2022 as a Sergeant and Cryptologic Linguist, deploying to southern Syria in support of Operation Inherent Resolve.
Career experience includes working as a stockbroker, banker, mortgage loan originator, and public defender.
Was the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma House of Representatives District 20 in 2024, losing to Republican Jonathan Wilk, 75.8% to 24.2%.
Says he is a father of five and lives in Newcastle, Oklahoma, with his wife and children.
